create_ModifyData_dataset: create a ModifyData PyTorch dataset that generates random voxel shape transformation tasks with text instructions
run_thicker_transform: run the thicker function to generate a random thickening or thinning transformation on a voxel schematic
run_scale_transform: run the scale function to generate a random scaling transformation like wider, taller, or bigger on a schematic
run_rotate_transform: run the rotate function to generate a 90 degree clockwise or counter-clockwise rotation transformation on a schematic
run_fill_transform: run the fill function to generate a fill or hollow transformation task on a voxel schematic
